newsitem.title: JAPAN: Soccer-Kashima retains lead in J.League.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Kashima retains lead in J.League.

text.p: Brazilian striker Jorginho scored a 25-metre (80 ft) free kick nine minutes from time on Saturday to give the Kashima Antlers a 2-1 win over Bellmare Hiratsuka, keeping his team on the top of Japan's J.League.
Kashima enter a month-long break in the J. League with a comfortable four-point lead over second-place Yokohama Flugels.
The Flugels suffered a 1-0 upset home defeat by Kyoto despite dominating most of the game.
Kobe, a newcomer to the league this season, defeated the Yokohama Marinos 2-1 on goals by veteran forward Akihiro Nagashima, who now leads the league with 11 goals.
Brazilian Jamelli scored twice before half-time to lift Kashiwa to a 4-1 home victory over Gamba Osaka. Kashiwa is now third behind the Flugels on goal difference.
An angled shot by Japan's ace striker Kazuyoshi Miura gave Kawasaki a 1-0 extra-time win over host Iwata.

In other matches, Nagoya edged Ichihara 3-2 for its fifth win in a row after losing the opening six, Hiroshima blanked Fukuoka 1-0 and Shimizu scored a 2-1 victory against Cerezo Osaka in extra time. Urawa did not play on Saturday.
League action will be suspended until July 2 because of the Kirin Cup and the second leg of the Asian zone World Cup first-round qualifying tournament.
